אורן עמנואל שושנה, מטפל גוף–נפש באמצעות: I’m Oren Emanuel Shoshana. I use medicinal plants to support body and mind, gather local plants, and create and sell a variety of natural extracts tailored to each person’s needs. I lead workshops in foraging and making herbal preparations, sharing a way of life connected to nature.
הטבע בשבילי הוא מקום לחיבור, יצירה, רפוא: For me, nature is a place for connection, creativity, healing and, above all, peace.
שמי אורן עמנואל שושנה, הרבליסט קליני במק: My name is Oren Emanuel Shoshana, and I’m a clinical herbalist. My practice brings together therapeutic conversation, nutrition and medicinal plants. I explore Israel’s plant life, forage and make herbal preparations, bringing an endless curiosity to my work that I hope to share with others. I live and work in Kadita, in the Galilee hills, where daily life keeps me connected to the land and its plants.
למדתי הרבליזם קליני בקמפוס ברושים, והדרך: I studied clinical herbalism at Broshim Campus. My work also brings together gardening, traditional orchard cultivation in Israel and leading herbal workshops. In addition to my daily practice, I’m helping to set up a medicinal herb farm in Greece in an advisory and practical role. I also share my knowledge and practical experience with researchers in the field. Every encounter with a plant, a place or a person teaches me something new, and I continue to share what I learn along the way.

החיים לצד הטבע מלמדים אותי לחיות עם העונ: Living close to nature teaches me to follow the seasons and notice what each change in the weather brings. Every plant has its own time to grow and flower. Each part of the plant—roots, leaves, stems and flowers—has its own properties and mix of compounds, which change throughout the year. Foraging is an art of understanding these differences and knowing what, when and how to gather, taking care to preserve the plant’s qualities and allow it to keep growing next season.
אותה תשומת לב ממשיכה גם ברקיחה. הכנת תמצ: I bring the same care to making herbal preparations. Making extracts and distilling essential oils takes patience, attention and familiarity with the raw material. Careful attention to timing, temperature and every stage of the process allows the plant’s qualities to come through in a well-made preparation.

התהליך יכול להתאים למצבים כמו סטרס יומיו: This approach may be suitable for people experiencing daily stress, anxiety, depression, sleep difficulties, fatigue, chronic digestive conditions or chronic skin conditions. Its aim goes beyond quick symptom relief to gradually support the body’s natural processes and its ability to address underlying concerns over time. The pace varies from person to person, depending on the condition, how long it has been present and the individual response. Herbal care may be used on its own or alongside medical treatment, with care, monitoring and careful judgment.

סדנה מעשית שמחברת לחומר דרך הידיים: מכיר: A workshop that connects you with plants through practical work: discover local medicinal plants, learn to identify them and gather roots responsibly.
עובדים עם השורשים שליקטנו: מרגישים את המ: Work with the roots we gather: feel their textures, clean and process them, and turn them into natural herbal preparations.
לצד העשייה נלמד על שימושי המרפא של השורש: Alongside the practical work, learn about the roots’ medicinal uses through traditional knowledge and available research.
הסדנה מתקיימת לאורך השנה. בחירת הצמחים ו: The workshop runs throughout the year. Plants and activities are chosen according to availability, taking care to protect vegetation and its ability to regenerate.
בטבע, באזור קדיתא והגליל העליון או במקום: Outdoors in the Kadita area and the Upper Galilee, or another suitable location in Israel, with space for practical work with roots.
הרצאה חווייתית שפותחת חלון לעולם צמחי המ: An engaging talk opening a window onto medicinal plants and the connection between people, land and wellbeing.
אורן מביא איתו מגוון צמחי מרפא נפוצים בג: Oren brings a selection of familiar garden herbs, such as sage, rosemary, thyme, white savory and lemongrass. Meet the plants up close and learn about their qualities and uses.
לומדים איך להכין תה כדי להפיק את האיכויו: Learn how to make herbal tea to bring out the plant’s qualities, and how and when to include it in daily life, with attention to safe use and individual needs.
בסוף ההרצאה המשתתפים מרכיבים לעצמם חליטה: At the end, participants create their own herbal tea blend based on what they have learned. The talk suits companies, communities and groups, with no limit on participant numbers.
באזור קדיתא והגליל העליון או במקום אחר ב: In the Kadita area and the Upper Galilee, or elsewhere in Israel: at a community space, guesthouse, hall or office.
כל אדם מסתקרן מהדברים קצת אחרת. אם יש מש: Everyone has their own interests. If there is something specific you would like to learn, we’ll build a session around your curiosity and needs.
אפשר להעמיק בצמחי מרפא, ארומתרפיה, ליקוט: Explore medicinal plants, aromatherapy, foraging, growing herbs, distillation, creating herbal formulas and making natural preparations, or get to know the world of mushrooms.
התוכן נבנה לפי הצורך והעניין של האדם, הז: Content is shaped by the needs and interests of the individual, couple or group, as well as the season, location and preference for an indoor or outdoor session.
אפשר לתכנן מפגש אישי, דייט ייחודי לזוגות: Plan an individual session, a special date for two or a workshop for up to 30 participants, as a one-off experience or part of a series.
באזור קדיתא והגליל העליון, או במקום מפגש: In the Kadita area and the Upper Galilee, or another location in Israel that we choose together: outdoors, at home, at a guesthouse, in a community space or at the office.
פרץ מעלעלים ואורן מציגים את הסמבוק השחור: Peretz from Al-Alim and Oren introduce black elder and discuss its traditional uses.
היכרות מן השטח עם הבוצין המפורץ והשימושי: Meet wavy-leaved mullein in the field and explore the traditional uses associated with it.
אורן מספר על האזוב, המוכר גם כזעתר, ועל: Oren introduces za’atar, also known locally as ezov, and its place in local herbal traditions.
אורן מציג את צמח הוולריאנה ומשתף בידע מס: Oren introduces valerian and shares traditional knowledge about its qualities and uses.
מפגש ביער עם שרף האורן ועם הידע המסורתי: An encounter with pine resin in the forest and the traditional knowledge surrounding it.
אורן יוצא לליקוט חורפי ומציג את החרחבינה: Oren goes winter foraging and introduces blue eryngo in its natural habitat.
מפגש עם צמח הקומפרי במהלך יציאה ליער וסי: Meet comfrey on a forest outing and hear about its traditional uses.
ליקוט כוכבית בקדיתא והיכרות עם הצמח ועם: Foraging chickweed in Kadita and getting to know the plant and its habitat.
מפגש עם אורן ועם עולם הצמחים, הליקוט והר: Meet Oren and explore plants, foraging and home herbal preparations.

הכנת סירופ מאצטרובלים ירוקים: Making syrup from green pine cones
מליקוט האצטרובלים הירוקים ועד ההשריה בסו: From gathering green pine cones to layering them with sugar, heating and straining. Oren and Ohad demonstrate the stages of making traditional pine cone syrup.
פרץ מעל־עלים מספר על מסורות עממיות שנקשר: Peretz from Al-Alim shares folk traditions associated with elder stems and how they reached Yodfat. A conversation about herbal folklore, not guidance on caring for infants.
אורן מציג את פריחת העוזרר ואת פירותיו, ו: Oren introduces hawthorn flowers and fruit, discussing the plant’s traditional association with the heart. How do herbal traditions use its flowers and fruit differently?
הליבה האכילה של הגדילן: The edible center of milk thistle
מבט בתפרחת הצעירה של הגדילן ובהתפתחות הז: A close look at a young milk thistle flower head and its developing seeds. Oren peels back the fibers to reveal a core that tastes like artichoke.
פתיחה לסדרת סרטונים על חסת המצפן, קרובת: The opening video in a series about prickly lettuce, a wild relative of garden lettuce. Oren introduces the plant and its traditional use as a calming herb.
מהי חלימה צלולה, ואיך נקשרה לחסת המצפן ב: What is lucid dreaming, and how has it been associated with prickly lettuce in herbal traditions? Oren discusses awareness during dreams and the plant’s traditional role in this context.
צורות העלים של חסת המצפן: The different leaf shapes of prickly lettuce
אותו הצמח, מראה שונה: עלים שלמים מול עלי: The same species can look quite different: some plants have unlobed leaves, others have deeply lobed leaves, and their heights vary. A comparison in the field shows the differences between individual prickly lettuce plants.
רגע קליל בין עצי האורן: אורן מנסה לקלוע: A playful moment among the pines as Oren aims a green cone at the foraging basket. A short forest clip of “pine cone basketball”.
מתחילים להבחין בין גדילן לברקן: Telling milk thistle and Syrian thistle apart
שני קוצים דומים צומחים זה לצד זה, אבל אי: Two similar thistles grow side by side, but how do you begin to tell them apart? A first look at milk thistle and Syrian thistle before examining their leaf markings.
פרחים לבנים, חליטה אדומה: אורן מציג את ש: White flowers, red tea: Oren shows the color change in the cup. A demonstration using young hawthorn shoot tips, flowers and leaves.
היכרות עם פירות האלה הארץ־ישראלית ועם הט: Meet the fruit of the Palestine terebinth and its tangy, aromatic flavor. Oren discusses drying the fruit, separating the pulp and using it as a spice and adding it to coffee.
מבט מקרוב בענף העוזרר כדי להבדיל בין הצמ: A close look at a hawthorn branch distinguishes older growth from this year’s green shoots. Oren shows which shoot tips are gathered with the flowers and leaves.
הנוזל הלבן שבחסת המצפן: The white sap of prickly lettuce
מהו הנוזל הלבן שמופיע בגבעול הפצוע? אורן: What is the white liquid that appears on a damaged stem? Oren shows prickly lettuce latex during flowering and describes how it was traditionally collected.
מי גרה, לפי האגדה, בין גזעי הסמבוק? פרץ: Who lives among the elder stems, according to legend? Peretz from Al-Alim shares the tale of the witch in the shrub and the links between warnings and healing stories in European folklore.
צמח רעיל: הסרטון מתעד ניסיון של אורן ואו: Poisonous plant: this video documents Oren and Ohad’s mandrake jam experiment and the warnings that accompany it. Documentation only, not a recipe to try at home.
אורן ממלא צנצנת בפרחי קלנדולה ומדגים את: Oren fills a jar with calendula flowers to begin an oil infusion. He discusses packing the flowers, choosing a carrier oil and calendula’s traditional use in skin preparations.
אחרי שלושה חודשי השריה, אורן מסנן וסוחט: After three months of infusion, Oren strains and presses the calendula flowers using cloth and a press. This is the oil-extraction stage before making a salve, not the complete salve recipe.
העלים והשימושים המסורתיים של הבוצין: Mullein leaves and their traditional uses
אורן מציג את עלי הבוצין, את הכסות השעירה: Oren introduces mullein leaves and their fine covering of hairs, and explains how the leaves are cleaned and dried. He discusses their traditional use in herbal teas and for smoking; this is not a recommendation to smoke.
איסוף אבקנים מאורן קנרי וקפריסאי: Collecting pollen from Canary Island and Cyprus pines
מה ההבדל בין התפרחות הזכריות של אורן קנר: How do the male flower clusters of Canary Island pine and Cyprus pine differ? A comparison in the kitchen of flower cluster size, pollen yield and collection methods.
הריח והמרירות של הגעדה: The aroma and bitterness of germander
אורן מציג את הגעדה בשטח ומתבונן בעלים, ב: Oren introduces germander in its natural habitat, exploring its leaves, aromatic scent and characteristic bitterness. Get to know this local plant and its place in herbal traditions.
מבט על שני עצים סמוכים כדי להבין מתי התפ: Two neighboring trees reveal the difference between closed flower clusters and those that have already released their pollen. Oren shows the different flowering stages and the signs that indicate when to gather the pollen.
ההבדלים בין עלי הגדילן והברקן: Comparing milk thistle and Syrian thistle leaves
השוואה מקרוב בין דגמי הלבן על העלים של ה: A close comparison of the white patterns on milk thistle and Syrian thistle leaves. Oren points to how the markings relate to the veins to illustrate the difference.
מה קורה לסירופ אצטרובלים בחימום?: What happens when pine cone syrup is heated?
מה קורה לסירופ האצטרובלים בזמן החימום? א: What happens to pine cone syrup during heating? Oren discusses vitamin C and the substances in pine cones that create a dry feeling in the mouth.
פירות הדודא במקרא ובמסורת: Mandrake fruit in the Bible and folklore
מפגש עם פירות הדודא בשלבי הבשלה שונים וע: Discover mandrake fruit at different stages of ripening, along with the stories associated with it in the Bible and folklore. The video also addresses toxicity and caution; it is not a recommendation to eat the plant or use it for self-treatment.
ליד הנחל, אורן משווה בין פירות פטל בשלבי: Beside the stream, Oren compares blackberries at different stages of ripening. He looks at their color, feel and how easily they come away from the cluster, while showing how to reach carefully between the thorns.
סיור במרכז צמחי המרפא על־עלים: A tour of the Al-Alim herbal center
ביקור במרכז על־עלים שבציפורי, בין צמחי מ: A visit to Al-Alim in Tzippori, among medicinal herbs, mushrooms, resins and spices. Oren and Ohad explore the shelves and discuss ingredient quality and drying.
זיהוי מרווה משולשת והכנת חליטה: Identifying Greek sage and preparing an infusion
למה קוראים לה מרווה משולשת? אורן מציג את: Why is this sage called “three-lobed” in Hebrew? Oren shows its leaf structure, compares it with common sage and discusses infusions and traditional uses.
אילו אצטרובלים מתאימים להכנת סירופ? אורן: Which pine cones are used for syrup? Oren compares sizes and stages of development, showing the softness he looks for in green cones.
ריח הדודא והזהירות בשימוש בו: The scent of mandrake and cautions around its use
אורן מציג את ריח העלים והפירות של הדודא: Oren discusses the scent of mandrake leaves and fruit and its association with fertility stories and folklore. The conversation includes a toxicity warning and is not a guide to eating or self-treatment.
השערות הצורבות של הסרפד: A closer look at nettle’s stinging hairs
מבט מקרוב בשערות הצורבות של הסרפד ובהבדל: A close look at nettle’s stinging hairs and how their density varies along the plant. Oren demonstrates his approach to gathering and preparing the leaves in the field.
כרמלית נאה ומשפחת המצליבים: Identifying the mustard family with karmelit na’a
דרך פרחי הכרמלית הנאה, אורן מציג את מבנה: Using karmelit na’a flowers, Oren shows four separate petals arranged in a cross. A conversation about identifying features of the mustard family and its characteristic pungency.
שיחה עם פרץ על סמבוק שחור: Talking about black elderberry with Peretz
פרץ מעל־עלים משוחח עם אורן על גבעולי הסמ: Peretz from Al-Alim talks with Oren about elder stems, folk beliefs and the origin of the plant’s name. A record of traditions and stories, not guidance on caring for infants.
היכרות עם הבוצין המפורץ ועם העלים המכוסי: Get to know wavy-leaved mullein and its leaves covered in fine hairs. Oren shows how the leaves are prepared and discusses their traditional use in herbal teas and for smoking, without recommending smoking.
האזוב במטבח ובמסורת המקומית: Za’atar in cooking and local herbal traditions
האזוב שמוכר כזעתר, מהעלים הריחניים ועד ה: Meet the aromatic leaves of za’atar, or local hyssop, and their place in salads and soups. Oren discusses the plant’s flavor and role in local herbal traditions.
בין צמחי הבר מסתתרת ולריאנה איטלקית, קרו: Italian valerian, a relative of medicinal valerian, hides among the wild plants. Oren shows its leaves and explains why the root, with its distinctive smell, is the part traditionally used.
למה עץ האורן מפריש שרף, ומה רואים סביב פ: Why does a pine tree release resin, and what can be seen around an old trunk wound? Oren discusses resin gathering, gentle heating in a water bath and straining the infused oil.
שלבי הצמיחה של חרחבינה מכחילה: The growth stages of blue eryngo
איך משתנה החרחבינה מעלים צעירים ועגולים: How does blue eryngo develop from a young plant with round leaves into a mature, spiny plant? Oren shows its growth stages and explains the difference between using the leaves in cooking and the roots in traditional herbal preparations.
קומפרי וזהירות בשימוש בו: Comfrey and precautions for its use
אורן מציג את הקומפרי ביער ומספר על השימו: Oren introduces comfrey in the forest and discusses its traditional use in external preparations. The discussion emphasizes the warning against taking the plant internally.
מפגש עם הכוכבית הגדלה בין מחטי האורן בקד: Meet chickweed growing among pine needles in Kadita. Oren describes its soft, mucilaginous texture and discusses its place in cooking and traditional external preparations.
